G'oya

Ikki jadvalni mijozga bitta JOIN bilan ulab bo'lmaydi: uchta buyurtma va ikkita to'lovi bor mijozda olti qator hosil bo'ladi va ikkala summa ko'payib ketadi. Har bir jadvalni avval o'zi alohida mijoz bo'yicha yig'ish kerak: shunda har bir mijozga ikkala tomondan ko'pi bilan bitta qator ulanadi. Bonus sifatida bu tez ham: har bir jadval bir martadan o'qiladi.

Yechim

WITH o AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
p AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.id, c.name,
       COALESCE(o.total, 0) AS ordered,
       COALESCE(p.total, 0) AS paid
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN p ON p.customer_id = c.id

Tuzoqlar

Birdan ulash xato natija beradi. Namunada Aziz ikki buyurtma (800 000) va bitta to'lov qilgan, lekin ikkinchi testda uch buyurtma va ikki to'lov bor: buyurtmalar ikki marta, to'lovlar uch marta qo'shiladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT c.id, c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS ordered,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS paid
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name

Har bir mijoz uchun ikkita ichki so'rov to'g'ri natija beradi. Lekin customer_id bo'yicha indeks yo'q, va PostgreSQL har bir mijoz uchun ikkala jadvalni boshidan oxirigacha o'qiydi: uch ming mijozda 30 milliondan ortiq qator.

SELECT c.id, c.name,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id), 0) AS ordered,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id), 0) AS paid
FROM customers c

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da ichki so'rovli yechim ham tez. U ichki so'rov ko'p marta bajarilishini ko'radi va orders.customer_id, payments.customer_id bo'yicha vaqtinchalik indeks quradi (AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX). PostgreSQL bunday indeks qurmaydi.
